persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramalladevasana īśānakoṭhāyā mahānavamīyā gaṇakaumārārcana saṃphulī || dayakā juroṃ

notes: The manuscript of the Gaṇakaumārārcana manual (saṃphulī) for the Mahānavamī festival of the Īśānakoṭhā shrine/room was commissioned by King Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur. Scribe remains anonymous ('mayā'). The mentioned 'upādhyā', 'ācā' (ācārya), and 'josi' (jośī) are designations for eligible practitioners/readers, not specific individuals.
